attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `yceK`, a YceK/YidQ family lipoprotein, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, and the model names it in 99% of genomes at 0.04 bits. Then columns 1 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 67% of calls, named in 59 to 99%.

**The first forks carry curli and glucan genes.** Columns 1 to 17 run from `mdoH` to `ghrA`, through `mdoG`, `mdoC` and the `csg` genes, [[curli assembly and glucan biosynthesis]], most at 83 to 90%. A second branch of 23 families through columns 3 to 25, `lpxL` to `flgE`, is carried by 10% of chromosomes, persistent. Column 18, `ycdU`, is the most hesitant of the window: 2.13 bits, named 59%, in a region of plasticity in 63% of calls.

**Then the `pga` and `rut` stretches.** Columns 20 to 24, `dgcT` to `pgaD`, [[poly-beta-1,6 N-acetyl-D-glucosamine synthesis]], sit at 46 to 59%, and columns 31 to 39, `putA` to `rutG`, [[pyrimidine utilization]], at 78 to 81%. A second branch of 9 families through columns 36 to 44, `yceD` to `pabC`, and one of 4 through columns 46 to 49, `tmk` to `ptsG`, are each carried by 10%, persistent. Column 49, `torC`, hesitates 0.76 bits.

**The `tor`, `gfc` and `hya` stretches follow.** Columns 47 to 51, `torD` to `torT`, [[trimethylamine-N-oxide reduction]], and columns 59 to 63, `gfcA` to `gfcE`, [[capsule biosynthesis]], at 50 to 52%. Columns 69 to 74, `appC` to `hyaB`, [[hydrogenase and oxidase subunits]], are variable at 63 to 65%. The window ends at column 79, `rlmI`, in 54% of chromosomes.

**The model names readily on persistent genes and hesitates inside plasticity.** Persistent calls: named 99%, 0.18 bits. Shell: named 76%, 1.29 bits. Cloud: named 25%, 4.11 bits. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 1.44 against 0.21 bits, and names fewer genes, 76% against 97%.

label: yceK
facts:
WINDOW: the yceK window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yceK, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,642 to 2,721 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yceK once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.50 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,059 calls, named 99%, 0.18 bits; shell 10,204 calls, named 76%, 1.29 bits; cloud 697 calls, named 25%, 4.11 bits. Outside an RGP 32,596 calls, named 97%, 0.21 bits; inside an RGP 10,364 calls, named 76%, 1.44 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 63 fork, 16 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.44 against 0.21 bits) and names fewer genes (76% against 97%); 10,364 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 18 (ycdU) 2.13 bits, RGP 63%; column 19 ("IS3 family transposase") 1.33 bits, RGP 67%; column 49 (torC) 0.76 bits, RGP 23%. The 11 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 87%, 0.78 bits on average; the other 69 columns: named 93%, 0.46 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0.2-67%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: yceK "YceK/YidQ family lipoprotein". named 99%; 0.04 bits.
